connector.name: Data by thinair.co
connector.registryDescription: Read-only PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server access via MCP - 24 dialect-aware hosted tools.
connector.summary: Hosted at data.thinair.co over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace co.thinair, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Paste `Bearer ta_data_...`. Get a key by pasting your database DSN at https://data.thinair.co/connect.
